answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a violet header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a anchor spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 95 answers an epoch hence costs 49 real forward passes, and the falcon record lets any auditor recompute the check. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
